events.name: Rewind: 2000s Halloween Rave
events.info: Step into our time machine and relive the early 2000s like never before. This isnt just a throwback party its a fully produced 2000s rave experience. Expect the biggest Y2K hits reworked through exclusive edits, remixes, and mashups created by our producers, built specifically for the modern dancefloor. From pop and hip-hop to electronic anthems, every moment is designed to hit harder, louder, and bigger than you remember. High-energy visuals, immersive production, euphoric sing-alongs, and nonstop nostalgia this is the 2000s the way it was meant to be felt. Dress in your best 2000s-inspired Halloween fit, bring the whole crew, and dance all night to reworked bangers from: Britney Spears · Usher · Lady Gaga · Rihanna · Beyoncé · Justin Timberlake · Katy Perry · Black Eyed Peas · 50 Cent · Flo Rida · T-Pain · Ke$ha · Akon · Pitbull · Sean Paul · Kanye West · Jay-Z · Nelly · Lil Jon · Ne-Yo & more.
events.pleaseNote: Halloween attire is encouraged. PLEASE NOTE THE FOLLOWING COSTUME GUIDELINES: No weapons (including fake swords, hammers, etc.) No spikes or chains No prop guns No full masks masks must be removable, and guests must be identifiable for ID and/or alcohol service Gloves cannot impede 21+ wristbands Full face paint is permitted, but eyes must not be covered
